title: A slab gyrotropic in both eps and mu, at normal incidence
source: S. Poddar, MS thesis, University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee (2020), Appendix A (Eqs. A.1-A.151); also arXiv 2205.03560
notes: Poddar derives r, t, Faraday and Kerr rotation in closed form and gives no numbers; the values here are chosen. Both tensors have the form [[a, -i b, 0], [i b, a, 0], [0, 0, c]], so they share circular eigenvectors: the circular waves see (eps + g, mu + kappa) and (eps - g, mu - kappa). The test checks the eigenvalues of the transmission Jones matrix against the two circular Airy transmissions. Poddar works in exp(+jwt); the tensors here are already in this program's exp(-iwt).
